pages.title: Mundane Hexbrew
pages.text: The foundation of all brewing: a plain water-based stock with no drink or splash effect. Every other brew starts from it, and bottles carry 250 mB each.

pages.title: Explosive Hexbrew
pages.text: A throwable bottle that bursts into a power-4 explosion. Blocks are left intact, and you and your allies are spared: pure anti-monster artillery.

pages.title: Miasma Hexbrew
pages.text: A throwable bottle inflicting Miasma for 60 seconds: victims take 50 percent more damage with halved armor. Made for softening up anything tough.

pages.title: Hexbrew Elixir
pages.text: A condensed brew that cannot be drunk or thrown: its value is with Marisa. Earn a bottle from her brewing quest, or trade her 4 mundane bottles for one at 80 reputation.

pages.title: Shield Hexbrew
pages.text: Drink it for Starlight Shield: 60 seconds of extra absorption. It is not brewed in the pot; trade for it with Marisa at 50 reputation.

pages.title: Starlight Hexbrew
pages.text: A throwable starburst dealing 4 magic damage and marking victims with Sparkling for 60 seconds. Every hit a sparkling victim takes erupts into a ring of 16 star bullets that fight for you. Marisa's stock, at 120 reputation.

pages.title: Hyphae Hexbrew
pages.text: A throwable bottle inflicting Hyphae Infection for 60 seconds (1 magic damage per second) while seeding transient hyphae and turning nearby dirt into mycelium within 4 blocks. Not obtainable in survival yet.
